title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty: Coverage Periods by Defect Category
content:
**1. Basis of decision.** Each claim item under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is decided against the coverage period of its defect category, mapped as follows.

| Defect category | Coverage period |
|---|---|
| drywall, paint, trim carpentry, doors and hardware, cabinets and countertops, flooring, tile, concrete flatwork, exterior siding, masonry veneer | workmanship |
| plumbing, electrical, hvac | systems |
| foundation slab, load-bearing framing | structural |
| roofing | roof leak |
| window seal | window seal |
| landscaping | landscaping |
| grading and drainage | grading and drainage |
| appliances | appliance |
| termite | termite |

**2. The four dated periods.** A workmanship item is covered only when it is reported no later than the program's late-report grace days after the workmanship end date. A systems item, a structural item and a roof leak item are each covered only when reported no later than the late-report grace days after the systems end date, the structural end date and the roof leak end date respectively. The grace days count from the day after the end date and the last grace day is included; where the grace is zero days, the last covered reporting day is the end date itself. The grace applies only to these four dated periods.

**3. Item periods counted in months.** A window seal item is covered only when it is reported within the window seal months after the coverage start date; grading and drainage, appliance and termite items are covered when reported within the grading and drainage, appliance and termite months after the coverage start date respectively. Calendar months are counted to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of a shorter month; that day closes the period, a report received earlier than it is covered, and the reporting date equal to the last covered day (the day before it) is covered.

**4. Landscaping.** A landscaping item is covered only when it is reported within the landscaping days after the coverage start date. Item periods counted in days start the day after the coverage start date and the last counted day is included.

**5. Appliances.** An appliance item reported after its period, or in a program whose appliance months are zero, is denied with reason "manufacturer warranty" and referred to the manufacturer.

**6. Late items.** An item reported after its period and grace is denied with reason "outside coverage period".

**7. Reporting date.** The reporting date is the date the written report was received, or the telephone date for an emergency. Where the program requires written reports, a non-emergency telephone report is recorded only once the homeowner submits it in writing, and the written date counts.

**8. Evidence.** The decision rests on the company's records: the end dates and coverage start date on the coverage record, and the reporting date recorded for the claim item, matched by its item number.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Situation | Reporting date | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Workmanship end date 14 March 2026, grace 7 days | 21 March 2026 | Covered: last grace day |
| Same | 22 March 2026 | Denied, outside coverage period |
| Systems end date 14 March 2026, grace 0 days | 14 March 2026 | Covered: the end date |
| Same | 15 March 2026 | Denied, outside coverage period |
| Coverage start 15 March 2024, window seal months 12 | 14 March 2025 | Covered: last covered day |
| Same | 15 March 2025 | Denied, outside coverage period |
| Coverage start 15 March 2024, landscaping days 30 | 14 April 2024 | Covered: last counted day |
| Program with 0 appliance months | any date | Denied, manufacturer warranty |
